unmapped_blocks.text: Skills
WORK EXPERIENCE
HPE ARUBA GLOBAL ESCALATION ENGINEER
HPE, Bengaluru, India
 Identify and resolve problems on high-end HPE switches.
 Implementation and troubleshooting of VLAN, high availability solutions like
Current
VRRP, LACP, ACL, NAT, DHCP-related issues, etc.
Worked on Virtual Switching Extension (VSX), Virtual Switching Framework
(VSF).
Working knowledge of authentication protocols like TACACS, RADIUS,
802.1X, UBT, and GRE.
 Troubleshooting packet drop issues, latency issues, and spanning tree.
 Troubleshooting complex LAN/WAN infrastructure, including routing
protocols like OSPF and BGP.
Dealing with escalating problems and providing RCA for critical issues.
 Have hands-on experience in handling highly critical network-down
situations.
Managing Aruba Central, NETEDIT, Aruba Fabric Composer, and
troubleshooting the issues.
Recreate customer issues in the lab to provide faster resolution.
 Resolved complex technical issues by analyzing system logs and
collaborating with cross-functional teams, enhancing customer
satisfaction.
Developed and implemented troubleshooting protocols for network and
software problems, significantly reducing resolution times.
Mentored junior engineers on best practices for incident management,
fostering a culture of continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.
 Optimized system performance by identifying and addressing recurring
technical problems, resulting in improved service uptime.
Collaborated with product teams to provide feedback on system
functionalities, ensuring alignment with customer needs and service
quality.
EDUCATION
May 2017 Bachelor of Engineering: ECE
NIE-IT Engineering College - Mysore, India
LANGUAGES
Certifications
Nimisha Susan Varghese
HPE ARUBA GLOBAL ESCALATION ENGINEER
skilled in troubleshooting robust LAN/WAN solutions. Expertise in L2/L3 troubleshooting and a deep
understanding of protocols such as OSPF, BGP, and TCP/IP ensure seamless network operations.
Proven ability to conduct comprehensive network analysis and deliver exceptional customer
support while effectively managing highly escalated situations. Committed to optimizing network
performance and enhancing system reliability through innovative solutions and strategic problem-
solving.
